title: Taken aboard a spacecraft from his Moscow apartment

tellings.quote: calling me. I approached the window and there was something like a translucent pipe glowing made of some matter.

plain: A man named Kiran Ilum Xenov, introduced as the former president of one of Russia's republics, says that in September 1997 he felt something calling him in his top-floor apartment in Moscow. He says that when he went to the window there was a glowing, see-through pipe of some strange material, and that he was taken aboard a spacecraft. He told this to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2025.
